critical_code_review_comments: ProfessionLanding.jsx is well-factored — single source of truth driven entirely by cfg from professionConfigs.js. Adding a new profession is now a one-line config addition + one-line route in App.js, which is exactly the pattern that should have existed since iteration 4 when /doctors was first introduced.

professionConfigs.js: tier data-testids are generated from name.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-') — this produces stable slugs (solo-counsel, solo-teacher, solo-manager, etc.) but is implicit. Consider an explicit `testId` field per tier in the config to make the mapping self-documenting (low priority, current behaviour is correct).
ProfessionLanding.jsx CTA submit (L28-32) correctly POSTs {audience: cfg.audience, source: `${cfg.slug}-page`} — verified end-to-end with page.on('request') for /attorneys.

Framer-motion whileInView with initial opacity:0 means Playwright's locator.inner_text() returns empty for off-screen sections. Tests now use evaluate('el.textContent') for assertions on below-the-fold copy (compliance/testimonial/CTA blocks). Not a code bug, just a testing-tooling note.

Backend unchanged in this iteration: AUDIENCE_COPY in server.py already had 'doctors','attorneys','teachers','managers' entries from iteration 4, so the new pages route through tailored emails out of the box. Verified by curl (per problem statement) and now also covered by the 3 new pytest cases.

Pre-existing (unchanged from prior iterations): server.py logger defined after _send_confirmation_email — works at runtime but stylistically should move logging setup above first usage. Not a blocker.
